metadata.description: Unique object catalog for tabletop dual_tasks and dual_tasks_l3 object-gallery rendering.
metadata.selection_policy: Deduplicate by object identity. For RoboTwin objects with multiple used model_ids, keep one existing representative model_id and retain all used_model_ids for provenance.
metadata.scale_policy: scale_usages records scale-related constructor arguments found at object construction sites. null means loader/default asset scale. gallery_* picks the first explicit usage when available, otherwise default.
metadata.pose_policy: pose_usages records statically extracted sapien.Pose constructor usages at object creation sites. gallery_pose uses only the representative quaternion; gallery layout overrides x/y and computes z from the loaded mesh.
